# video

## `sdk/video/audio.js`

The soundtrack of a video. Decoding a sound file needs Web Audio, which only exists in a page (not in a Worker): decodeSoundtrack() is the one part of the video task that runs in the page, before the task's Worker gets the samples. fitSoundtrack() is pure: it makes the samples exactly as long as the video, looping a short piece and fading in and out so nothing clicks.

### `SAMPLE_RATE`

The sample rate of every soundtrack (what the encoders take).

### `fitSoundtrack(sound, seconds, { fadeIn = 0.04, fadeOut = 0.6, cross = 0.25 } = {})`

Samples of one channel or two, exactly `seconds` long: cut, or looped with a
short cross-fade when the sound is shorter, then faded in and out.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `sound` | `{ sampleRate: number, channels: Float32Array[] }` |  |
| `seconds` | `number` |  |
| `[o]` | `{ fadeIn?: number, fadeOut?: number, cross?: number }` | in seconds |

Returns `{ sampleRate: number, channels: Float32Array[] }`: two channels

### `decodeSoundtrack(blob)`

Decode a sound file in the page (any format the browser plays), at
SAMPLE_RATE. Fails with unsupported-format when it is not a sound.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `blob` | `Blob` |  |

Returns `Promise<{ sampleRate: number, channels: Float32Array[] }>`.

### `soundtrackOf(audio)`

Whatever a caller passes as a soundtrack, as samples: a Blob or File (decoded
here, in the page), an AudioBuffer, or `{ sampleRate, channels }` already.

Returns `Promise<{ sampleRate: number, channels: Float32Array[] } \| null>`.

## `sdk/video/encode.js`

The exporter: frames (any frame source) and, if given, a soundtrack in, a video file out, with the browser's own encoders (WebCodecs) and the small writers of this module (mp4.js, webm.js). MP4 with H.264 where the browser encodes it, with AAC sound (or Opus where AAC is not offered); otherwise WebM with VP9 (or VP8) and Opus. It works in a Worker or in the page, and knows nothing of photos or cameras: any task that makes frames can use it (a video generated from text, for one).

### `defaultBitrate(width, height, fps)`

Bits per second of the video by default: generous, for a clean picture after a platform re-encodes it.

### `avcCandidates(width, height, fps)`

H.264 codec strings to try, best first (High profile; the level by size and rate).

### `chooseCodecs({ width, height, fps, bitrate = defaultBitrate(width, height, fps), audio = false, audioRate = 48000, container = 'auto', scope = globalThis })`

The encoders this browser offers for a video: container, video and audio
codec configurations, or a reason why it cannot.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `o` | `{ width: number, height: number, fps: number, bitrate?: number, audio?: boolean, audioRate?: number, container?: 'auto'\|'mp4'\|'webm', scope?: any }` |  |

Returns `Promise<{ container: 'mp4'\|'webm', video: VideoEncoderConfig, audio: AudioEncoderConfig\|null } \| { container: null, reason: string }>`.

### `encodeVideo({ width, height, fps, frames, frame, audio = null, container = 'auto', bitrate, keyEvery = 2, signal, onProgress, scope = globalThis })`

Encode a video.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `o` | `{ width: number, height: number, fps: number, frames: number, frame: (index: number, timestampUs: number) => (CanvasImageSource\|VideoFrame\|ImageData\|Promise<CanvasImageSource\|VideoFrame\|ImageData>), audio?: { sampleRate: number, channels: Float32Array[] } \| null, container?: 'auto'\|'mp4'\|'webm', bitrate?: number, keyEvery?: number, signal?: AbortSignal, onProgress?: (p: { stage: 'render'\|'mux', frame?: number, frames?: number }) => void, scope?: any }` | `frame` gives frame `index` (0 based); a VideoFrame it returns is closed here. `audio` holds one array of samples (-1 to 1) per channel, already as long as the video; `keyEvery` is in seconds. |

Returns `Promise<{ blob: Blob, mime: string, container: 'mp4'\|'webm', videoCodec: string, audioCodec: string\|null, width: number, height: number, fps: number, frames: number, seconds: number, bytes: number }>`.

## `sdk/video/mp4.js`

A small MP4 (ISO BMFF) writer for what WebCodecs encodes: one H.264 video track and at most one audio track (AAC or Opus), every sample in memory, the index (moov) before the data so the file plays while it downloads. Samples come in decode order with their presentation time; when the encoder reorders frames the writer adds composition offsets and an edit list. Pure: no browser API, Node tests it by reading the boxes back.

### Type `Mp4Sample`

```ts
{ data: Uint8Array, pts: number, duration: number, key: boolean }
```

`pts` and `duration` in the track's timescale; samples in decode order.

### Type `Mp4Video`

```ts
{ kind: 'video', codec: 'avc1', width: number, height: number, timescale: number, description: Uint8Array, colour?: { primaries: number, transfer: number, matrix: number, fullRange: boolean }, samples: Mp4Sample[] }
```

### Type `Mp4Audio`

```ts
{ kind: 'audio', codec: 'mp4a'|'opus', sampleRate: number, channels: number, timescale: number, description?: Uint8Array, preSkip?: number, bitrate?: number, samples: Mp4Sample[] }
```

### `audioSpecificConfig(rate, channels)`

AAC-LC AudioSpecificConfig for a rate and channel count (when the encoder gives none).

### `writeMp4({ video, audio = null, chunkSeconds = 0.5 })`

Write an MP4 file.

| Parameter | Type | |
|---|---|---|
| `o` | `{ video: Mp4Video, audio?: Mp4Audio\|null, chunkSeconds?: number }` |  |

Returns `Uint8Array[]`: the file, in parts (for a Blob)

### `readBoxes(bytes, start = 0, end = bytes.length)`

Read the boxes of an MP4 back (tests and checks): type, size, offset and the
children of the container boxes.

## `sdk/video/webm.js`

A small WebM (Matroska) writer, the fallback when this browser cannot encode H.264: one VP9 or VP8 video track and at most one Opus audio track, every block in memory, clusters that start at key frames, and cues so a player can seek. Pure: Node tests it by reading the elements back.

### `opusHead(channels, sampleRate, preSkip = 312)`

OpusHead for a stream (the codec's own header, as WebM carries it).

### Type `WebmBlock`

```ts
{ data: Uint8Array, us: number, key: boolean }
```

`us`: presentation time in microseconds

### `readElements(bytes, start = 0, end = bytes.length)`

Read top-level elements back (tests): id in hex, size, offset of the payload.
